sources.qualification: Residential mapping completeness varies; no occupancy inferred.

warnings: Official island projections are not observed neighborhood populations.
WorldPop R2025A is alpha; rejected island weights are never amplified.
Fallback origins are modeled assumptions; unverified resident locations remain explicit.
2030 conserves official totals using the same spatial support as 2026.
Non-administrative atoll aggregates, harbours and combined industrial-island projections cannot be assigned to individual islands and remain unallocated.
Greater Malé retains the existing separate baseline without recalibration.
Residential OSM closed ways and assembled multipolygon relations are used; inner holes are preserved, and mapping completeness remains unverified.

screeningAssumptions.qualification: Conservative screening rules, not measured accuracy or confidence intervals.
